supplements.title: Citraconate preserves T cell stemness and antitumor immunity.
supplements.summary: Citraconate supplementation preserves T cell function and enhances tumor-fighting immunity by maintaining cellular energy and reducing harmful oxidative damage.

supplements.title: Nootkatone as a multi-target modulator of the PD-L1/PD-1 signaling in pancreatic cancer: network pharmacology, docking, molecular dynamics, and DFT analysis.
supplements.summary: Nootkatone, a natural compound, shows promise against pancreatic cancer by targeting immune checkpoint pathways and multiple cancer-related signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Evaluation of the effects of diosmin in cyclophosphamide-induced nephrotoxicity: an experimental animal study.
supplements.summary: Diosmin, a natural compound, protected rat kidneys from damage caused by cyclophosphamide cancer treatment by reducing inflammation and cell death.

supplements.title: An Open-Label Pilot Intervention Trial to Prevent Diabetes in Prediabetic Adult Survivors of Childhood Cancer
supplements.summary: A combined metformin and digital lifestyle program safely helps prevent diabetes in prediabetic childhood cancer survivors.

supplements.title: Cepharanthine Reverses Gefitinib Resistance in NSCLC by Concurrently Inhibiting AKT/P70S6K Survival Signaling and Activating STING-Mediated Immune Response.
supplements.summary: Cepharanthine overcomes lung cancer drug resistance by blocking survival signals and activating immune responses against resistant tumor cells.

supplements.title: Design, synthesis and biological evaluation of novel ursolic acid derivatives as potent anti-pancreatic cancer agents.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a modified ursolic acid compound (MG9) that effectively kills pancreatic cancer cells by triggering cell death pathways.

supplements.title: Kaempferol ameliorates PCOS by alleviating metabolic and endocrine abnormalities as well as oxidative stress.
supplements.summary: Kaempferol, a plant compound, reduces hormonal imbalances, insulin resistance, and oxidative stress in rats with polycystic ovary syndrome.

supplements.title: Protective effects of dihydroartemisinin against sterile inflammation and oxidative stress in alveolar macrophages.
supplements.summary: Dihydroartemisinin, derived from Artemisia annua, protects lung cells from oxidative stress and inflammation in acute lung injury.

supplements.title: Amine functionalized TiO2 doped mesoporous bioactive glass coated curcumin infused 3d printed poly (L-lactic acid): A promising multifunctional scaffold with enhanced osteogenesis and tumour relapse inhibition characteristics.
supplements.summary: A 3D-printed scaffold combining curcumin and bioactive glass coating kills osteosarcoma cells while promoting bone regeneration.

supplements.title: Rationally designed BTO@MSN@PPy-PEG piezoelectric nanozyme for ultrasound/NIR-triggered synergistic piezodynamic-photothermal-chemo tumor therapy.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles combining ultrasound and laser activation to deliver triple therapy—piezoelectric, heat, and chemotherapy—for more effective tumor treatment.

supplements.title: Synergistic effect of piperine on curcumin in cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity through DNA fragmentation and cytokines gene expressions.
supplements.summary: Combining curcumin and piperine supplements significantly reduces kidney damage caused by cisplatin cancer treatment in rats.

supplements.title: Parthenolide inhibits the progression of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma by promoting ferroptosis through inhibiting UBD.
supplements.summary: Parthenolide, a natural compound, slows intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma growth by triggering cancer cell death through a specific molecular pathway.

supplements.title: Resveratrol inhibits aerobic glycolysis and promotes cuproptosis in acute myeloid leukemia via the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol kills acute myeloid leukemia cells by blocking a growth pathway and triggering copper-dependent cell death.

supplements.title: Targeting p38α, p38γ, and ERα with bioactive compounds from royal jelly for anti-breast cancer activity: A comprehensive in-silico study using fingerprint analysis, molecular dynamics, MEP, and PCA.
supplements.summary: Royal jelly compounds chrysin, galangin, and naringin show promise against breast cancer by binding strongly to key cancer-related proteins.

supplements.title: Ginkgetin enhances the antitumor effect of Taxol on human breast cancer MCF-7 cells via ferroptosis mediated by the MDM2-p53-YAP1 axis.
supplements.summary: Ginkgetin combined with Taxol enhances breast cancer cell death by triggering a natural cell death process called ferroptosis.

off_label.title: Transient p53/p21 activation selectively protects healthy human hair follicles and their stem cells from chemotherapy.
off_label.summary: A drug called ALRN-6924 protects healthy hair follicles and stem cells from chemotherapy damage by temporarily halting their growth.

off_label.title: Intranasal Ketamine for Existential Distress in Advanced Cancer.
off_label.summary: Intranasal ketamine rapidly reduces depression and existential distress in advanced cancer patients receiving palliative care.

off_label.title: An Open-Label Pilot Intervention Trial to Prevent Diabetes in Prediabetic Adult Survivors of Childhood Cancer
off_label.summary: A combined metformin and digital lifestyle program safely helps prevent diabetes in prediabetic childhood cancer survivors.

off_label.title: Topical Ruxolitinib as a Treatment of Anti-PD1 Induced Lichenoid Skin Toxicities: a Prospective Single-center Pilot Study
off_label.summary: Topical ruxolitinib cream may effectively treat skin rashes caused by anti-PD1 cancer immunotherapy, according to this pilot study of 22 patients.

off_label.title: Genetic characteristics and targeted treatments of primary bladder and urachal adenocarcinomas: a systematic review with pooled descriptive genomic analyses.
off_label.summary: Researchers cataloged genetic mutations and targeted drug treatments for rare bladder adenocarcinomas to guide personalized patient care decisions.

off_label.title: Association of MUC3A P258S mutation with advanced phase CML structural and in silico insights.
off_label.summary: A novel MUC3A mutation found exclusively in advanced chronic myeloid leukemia may serve as a progression biomarker and improve treatment response to Capmatinib.

off_label.title: The Effect of the Anticonvulsant Topiramate on Acetylcholine-Induced Calcium Signals is Linked to Sirt-1 Activity.
off_label.summary: Topiramate enhances acetylcholine-induced calcium signals in neuroblastoma cells through sirtuin-1 activity, revealing a new mechanism for the drug's anticonvulsant effects.

off_label.title: Evaluation of Combined Treatment With Atorvastatin and SREBP2 Inhibitors Against Colorectal Cancer Cells Under Two-dimensional and Three-dimensional Culture Models.
off_label.summary: Combining atorvastatin with SREBP2 inhibitors increases killing of colorectal cancer cells in laboratory models.

off_label.title: Sulfasalazine an Inhibitor of System xC - (Cystine/glutamate Antiporter), Combined With Recombinant Methioninase, Inhibits Both Cancer and Normal Cells, Suggesting Lack of Cancer Selectivity of Cysteine Restriction.
off_label.summary: Combining sulfasalazine and methioninase killed both cancer and normal cells, indicating this approach lacks cancer-selective effectiveness.

off_label.title: Pregabalin for Opioid-resistant Neuropathic Pain in Bone Metastases.
off_label.summary: Pregabalin effectively relieves nerve pain from bone cancer spread when opioids alone don't work.

off_label.title: Metformin Induces PARP1-mediated Cell Death in NPC/HK1 Human Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Cells.
off_label.summary: Metformin kills nasopharyngeal cancer cells by triggering a DNA repair protein called PARP1 to cause cell death.

off_label.title: Imipramine Targets Apoptosis, Metastasis, and EGFR/SRC-mediated EMT in Oral Cancer Cells.
off_label.summary: Imipramine, an antidepressant drug, kills oral cancer cells and prevents their spread by blocking key growth signals.

off_label.title: Two faces of Amitriptyline in an in vitro study on C6 glioma cells: The effects of Amitriptyline and its combination with Temozolomide and radiation.
off_label.summary: Amitriptyline shows anti-cancer effects on glioma cells but reduces radiation effectiveness and suppresses beneficial immune marker PD-L1.

off_label.title: Metformin enhances survival with immune checkpoint inhibitors in cancer patients: A meta-analysis.
off_label.summary: Metformin combined with immunotherapy significantly improves survival in cancer patients, particularly among Asian populations.

off_label.title: Repurposing Hetrombopag for Multiple Myeloma by Targeting PNPO: A Celastrol-Inspired Approach.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified hetrombopag as a drug that blocks PNPO, an enzyme overactive in multiple myeloma, stopping cancer cell growth and extending patient survival.

biomarkers.title: Assessment of Brain Tumor Response to Radiotherapy Using Noninvasive Spectroscopic Magnetic Resonance Imaging Techniques.
biomarkers.summary: Spectroscopic MRI can noninvasively track brain tumor response to radiotherapy by monitoring metabolic changes.

biomarkers.title: mTORC2 regulates lipid metabolism-driven TAMs via the PPAR-γ/CD36 pathway to promote liposarcoma progression.
biomarkers.summary: mTORC2 protein drives tumor-promoting immune cells in liposarcoma through a metabolic pathway, offering a potential treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Temporal analysis of two inducible human genes reveals post-transcriptional H3K4me3 deposition.
biomarkers.summary: H3K4me3 histone marks accumulate after transcription begins at inflammatory genes, functioning as a consequence rather than a trigger for gene activation.

biomarkers.title: Beyond Routine Surveillance Imaging for Melanoma: Emerging Technologies for Detecting Early Recurrence and Guiding Clinical Management.
biomarkers.summary: Emerging blood tests and immune imaging show promise for detecting melanoma recurrence earlier than standard imaging, potentially improving patient outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Immunotherapy in Localized Colorectal Cancer: Current Practice and Future Directions.
biomarkers.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitors show remarkable effectiveness in early-stage colorectal cancer with specific genetic features, potentially avoiding surgery for some patients.

biomarkers.title: Performance of artificial intelligence software: EndoAngel, EndoAID, CAD-EYE, GI Genius, and EndoScreener in adenoma detection: an extended network meta-analysis.
biomarkers.summary: AI-assisted systems improve colorectal adenoma detection during colonoscopy, but performance varies significantly between different software programs.

biomarkers.title: Breakthroughs and challenges of CAR-T cell therapy in treating hematologic malignancies of the central nervous system.
biomarkers.summary: CAR-T cell therapy shows promise against blood cancers in the brain, but challenges include limited cell trafficking, neurotoxicity, and antigen escape.

biomarkers.title: Development of Graves orbitopathy after thyroidectomy for thyroid cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Radioactive iodine treatment for metastatic thyroid cancer triggered Graves disease and eye inflammation years after initial thyroidectomy.

biomarkers.title: Long-Read HiFi Genome Sequencing Resolves Retrotransposon-Mediated Deletions in TANGO2 Deficiency Disorder.
biomarkers.summary: New sequencing technology identified hidden genetic deletions in TANGO2 deficiency disorder that standard tests had missed.

biomarkers.title: Outcomes and prognostic factors in melanoma patients with leptomeningeal disease: a retrospective cohort study.
biomarkers.summary: Melanoma patients with leptomeningeal disease have poor survival (median 3 months), but any treatment improves outcomes compared to none.

biomarkers.title: Rapid hyperacute intracranial deterioration following initiation of ipilimumab/nivolumab in BRAF V600E-mutant melanoma of unknown primary with brain metastases after BRAF/MEK inhibitor therapy: a case series.
biomarkers.summary: Three melanoma patients with brain metastases rapidly deteriorated and died within two weeks of switching from targeted therapy to immunotherapy.

biomarkers.title: FGD1 guanine nucleotide exchange factor drives secondary resistance to BRAF inhibition in melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: FGD1 protein drives melanoma resistance to BRAF inhibitor drugs, suggesting it as a potential new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: AR-targeted therapies sensitize prostate cancer to cuproptosis by transcriptionally activating FDX1.
biomarkers.summary: AR-targeted drugs make prostate cancer cells vulnerable to copper-induced death by activating the FDX1 protein, offering a new combination treatment strategy.

biomarkers.title: Fra-2 controls the response to the KRAS inhibitor MRTX-1133 in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Fra-2 protein drives resistance to KRAS inhibitors in pancreatic cancer by activating the mTOR pathway, suggesting dual targeting could improve treatment.

biomarkers.title: Phase Ia/Ib trial of the safety and efficacy of mobocertinib in combination with T-DM1 for patients with HER2-mutant solid tumors (WJOG16022M).
biomarkers.summary: Researchers tested combining two HER2-targeting drugs—mobocertinib and T-DM1—for HER2-mutant solid tumors in a safety and efficacy trial.

trials.title: The Effects of Body-Oriented Interventions on Cancer-Related Symptoms of Women Who Survived Breast Cancer: Protocol for a Systematic Review.
trials.summary: Researchers will review how body-oriented therapies help breast cancer survivors manage persistent symptoms and improve quality of life.

trials.title: Mindfulness enhancement through logotherapy in patients with mastectomized breast cancer: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
trials.summary: Logotherapy sessions significantly improved mindfulness levels in breast cancer patients who had mastectomies compared to a control group.

trials.title: Palliative care nurses' knowledge of the assessment and management of malignant fungating wounds: a scoping review.

trials.title: Predictive value of [18F]FDG PET/CT and index lymph node response following neoadjuvant pembrolizumab in resectable stage 3 melanoma: Real world data from the largest melanoma centres in the Netherlands.
trials.summary: PET/CT scans of lymph nodes can predict which stage III melanoma patients will respond well to immunotherapy before surgery.
